_about: W2-PROCESS rules. `stations`: placed kinds that run process jobs in the world (inputs leave the bag, sit on the station, finish on the wall clock while the player is away or offline, outputs wait on the station until collected). `recipes` per station: recipe ids from recipes.json with the station duration in real seconds (overrides recipes.json `seconds`, which stays the old stand-and-craft time). `stages`: progress thresholds that pick a props_manifest buildings.<kind>.stages[].id model. `fx`: smoke|steam emitter while a job runs. `in_place`: spec 08 processing opportunities. Station times are # ASSUMPTION values (spec 11 lists Durango:0 delegated times as unverified); tune here. No spoilage: spec 08 forbids a freshness timer the design does not require.

in_place._about: Spec 08 §2 in-place processing: recipes whose process_step is listed change the chosen instance itself (identity, provenance and properties carry, raw tag removed) and spend one processing opportunity, recorded in attributes.processed. `opportunities` per instance: # ASSUMPTION 2, spec 08's reconstruction estimate, not a confirmed constant. Steam spends one like any step; the PRD's steam-steam question stays open.
